lines: The fox bites!  The kitten misses the fox.
Agnes the Stripling           St:18 Dx:13 Co:18 In:7 Wi:9 Ch:8 Neutral

notes: The wished potions, scrolls, ring (engagement), wand (forked) and amulet (concave) are unidentified (only appearances known). The murky potion type has been called "maybe healing" by the player (still unidentified).
In 5.0 Valkyries start with a spear (not a long sword), a dagger and a small shield; these are identified. A hostile fox is adjacent south-east and just bit the hero (HP 13/16).
